tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Its editable surface includes prompt and task framing, tool definitions and schemas, argument preprocessing, skills, MCP providers, subagent structure, context management, verification, and finish logic.
tool_schema_source.note: Schemas are hand-edited by the evolution loop; MCP providers supply schemas.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The coding harness runs three stages: proposal, validation, and evaluation.
loop_primitives.note: Outer optimizer loop is a fixed pipeline with hill climbing or tree search; inner agent (Stirrup) is tool-calling react. Default outer strategy: hill climbing.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the evolution loop measures a baseline, proposes one bounded intervention, evaluates it, retains only an improvement, and repeats from the resulting frontier
planning_granularity.note: No plan object described for the agent under test.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Its editable surface includes prompt and task framing, tool definitions and schemas, argument preprocessing, skills, MCP providers, subagent structure
multi_agent_topology.note: Subagent structure is part of the editable search space; the default Stirrup baseline topology is not described, coded single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: tool definitions and schemas, argument preprocessing, skills, MCP providers, subagent structure
delegation_mechanism.note: Subagents are listed as an evolvable component; mechanism unspecified.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: it exposes the permitted repository and benchmark traces, applies a candidate patch, runs checks, and launches benchmark evaluations
human_in_loop.note: Fully automated loop; no human gating described.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A persistent memory ledger links patch, session, and evaluation artifacts and carries frontier scores, per-task outcomes, accepted hypotheses, and discarded attempts into later iterations.
long_term_memory.note: Ledger persists across optimizer iterations; 'skills' are an evolvable harness component.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The loop commits accepted candidates as the new frontier and refreshes the search traces. It reverts rejected, invalid, and crashed candidates to the prior frontier.
state_persistence.note: Frontier + ledger act as a checkpoint of the outer search; inner-agent resume not described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The validator checks scope, imports, and a single-task smoke test before benchmarking.
self_verification.note: Benchmarks graded by SQL verifiers/programmatic assertions fed back into the loop; 'verification' is an editable agent-harness surface.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Input:benchmarkD; fixed modelM; seed harnessh 0; proposerP; budgetB
retry_policy.note: Budget B bounds the outer-loop attempts; task-level retry for the agent under test is not described.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each candidate is a git diff against the current frontier, scoped to the benchmark’s editable directories and the shared agent framework.

termination_condition.note: Outer loop terminates at budget B; agent-level termination (finish logic is editable) not specified.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The performance gains also coincide with lower estimated GPT-5.4 inference cost per task
cost_controls.note: Cost is measured/reported but no budget, routing or caching mechanism is described.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: including the sandboxed code-execution environment, shell-based snapshot inspection, and structured JSON output
execution_isolation.note: Sandbox described; EnterpriseOps uses a 'strict Docker-backed server'. Exact isolation of the agent not stated.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: scoped to the benchmark’s editable directories and the shared agent framework
filesystem_access.note: Scoping applies to the optimizer's patches; agent-side filesystem access not described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The validator checks scope, imports, and a single-task smoke test before benchmarking. The evolution loop reverts candidates that fail any check without running the selection evaluation.
permission_model.note: Validator gates optimizer edits; no per-action authorisation for the agent under test is described.

tracing.evidence_quote: the proposer may inspect search-task trajectories and their evaluation outcomes to diagnose recurring failures
tracing.note: Trajectory/trace records with turn and tool-call counts (Tables 3-5).

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: it exposes the permitted repository and benchmark traces, applies a candidate patch, runs checks, and launches benchmark evaluations
eval_hooks.note: Evaluator runs benchmarks inside the loop; repo itself is empty at the pin.

guardrails.evidence_quote: guardrails prevent it from encoding task-specific solutions
guardrails.note: Guardrails constrain optimizer patches (forbidden changes, scope/import/smoke checks).

target_domain.note: Enterprise ITSM/SRE/finance workflow domains via MCP and tool use.
